title: 3.3 Average Velocity and Instantaneous Velocity
description: Average Velocity and Instantaneous Velocity concepts and applications. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A cyclist rides 8 km east, 5 km west, then 3 km east in 2 h. Taking east as positive, what is the average velocity?
A cyclist rides 8 km east, 5 km west, then 3 km east in 2 h. What is the average speed?
A particle moves from x = 6 m at 0 s to x = -10 m at 4 s and to x = 2 m at 8 s. Taking +x as positive, what is the average velocity over 0 to 8 s?
A particle moves from x = 6 m at 0 s to x = -10 m at 4 s and to x = 2 m at 8 s. What is the average speed over 0 to 8 s?
A car travels 60 km east in 1 h and 40 km west in 1 h. Taking east as positive, what is the average velocity?
A car travels 60 km east in 1 h and 40 km west in 1 h. What is the average speed?
A swimmer crosses a 50 m pool south in 25 s and returns in 25 s. Taking south as positive, what is the average velocity for the first half?
A swimmer crosses a 50 m pool south in 25 s and returns in 25 s. Taking south as positive, what is the average velocity for the second half?
A swimmer crosses a 50 m pool south in 25 s and returns in 25 s. What is the average velocity for the round trip?
A bus is at 12 km at t = 1 h and 30 km at t = 2 h. What is its average velocity in m/s?
A car instantaneous velocity at 5 s is 20 m/s east and its average velocity over 0 to 5 s is 12 m/s east. Which value is the speedometer reading?
A particle moves with constant velocity -3 m/s along x for 10 s. What is its displacement?
A runner moves 100 m north in 20 s then 100 m south in 30 s. Taking north as positive, what is the average velocity?
A runner moves 100 m north in 20 s then 100 m south in 30 s. What is the average speed?
A car has average velocity 36 km/h west for 15 min. What is its displacement?
A particle position is x = 4t - 12 in metres along x. What is its average velocity from t = 2 s to t = 5 s?
A car moves 30 km east, 10 km west, then 10 km east in 2 h. Taking east as positive, what is the average velocity?
A car moves 30 km east, 10 km west, then 10 km east in 2 h. What is the average speed?
A train instantaneous velocity at 4 s is -10 m/s along a +x reference. What is its instantaneous speed?
A body moves with average velocity 0 m/s over 8 s while covering 160 m. Which quantity equals 160 m?
